What's new in 1.2.0

New template: ADHD
- A cinematic opening shot, drawn from your GitHub data: a camera's autofocus hunts through a storm of notifications, open tabs, a sticky note and a to-do list, then locks onto your name. The colours snap together, a lens flare fires, and everything else fades into the background.
- The soft lights behind your name are your year, one per month, brighter for busier months.
- Signal: a browser with far too many tabs open, your projects among the rabbit holes. Inside, your last 365 days drawn as a seismograph with your biggest hyperfocus streaks marked, a clock with only two times on it (now, and not now), rolling counters for your stats, and your languages as "dopamine by source".
- A film-slate sign-off: "Thanks for your attention. I know it's a limited resource."
- Options: the thought on the sticky note, the closing line and the postscript.
- Animated, with dark and light versions, and it respects reduced motion.
